resources.string: Play/Pause opens panel in other apps
Enable Remote button helper in Accessibility. Home interception does not change the system default launcher.

If the firmware does not offer a Home picker, connect ADB from your computer and run:

%1$s

Then press the real Home button and check the result. This command does not disable Google TV. Turn debugging off when finished.
This launcher is already your default Home.

This TV firmware does not expose the standard Home selection dialog. Opening Google TV does not make this launcher the default. Home must be configured separately for this TV, for example through ADB. The remote button helper does not change the default Home.
Choose a background, rotate the six built-in Apple TV style landscapes, or use your own theme pictures. Changes apply when you return Home.
Smoother gradients with less banding. Uses more memory than standard wallpaper color.
The sky follows your city’s sunrise and sunset. Race information appears near a race weekend. City search uses Open-Meteo; calendar updates use Jolpica.
Could not load the data. Your saved choices and calendar are unchanged. Please try again.
No matching cities found. Try adding the country.
Shows the drifting clock after Home is left untouched. It never interrupts a show or another app. Any key returns to Home.
Choose an app to change its name, launch destination or artwork. These choices survive theme changes.
An action offered by this app, such as its program guide. Leave blank to open the app normally.
This app does not offer that action.
Could not read this image. Choose a smaller image under 8 MB.
This TV has no image picker installed. Install a file manager that supports choosing images, then try again.

Assign an app or launcher action to single, double or triple presses. The optional helper in Accessibility handles buttons in other apps. Choose a button for the control panel, or use a held Home press. Play/Pause can open the panel instead of controlling video. Back, volume and navigation stay unchanged.
Opens apps assigned to remote buttons and the TV input switcher. Only remote key presses are handled; screen content is not read.
Press the remote button you want to assign. Press Back to cancel.

On Google TV (Android 14) you must allow restricted settings before enabling Accessibility:

1. Choose "App settings", scroll down and select "Allow restricted settings".
2. Then open "Accessibility" and turn on the helper.

Or run via ADB:
adb shell appops set com.gathin.tvhome ACCESS_RESTRICTED_SETTINGS allow
Show unfinished movies and episodes from the app selected in the dock. Apps with no unfinished items show no row. Up selects a show; Down returns to your apps.
Allow TV listings access to show Continue Watching from your apps.
This item is no longer available. Open its app to continue watching.
